text:
jamie: pinged by customer - intermittent 403s on SAML return after their IdP rolled keys yesterday evening. Only some users behind a CDN edge path hit errors. can someone look? :eyes:
elena-customer: repro steps I sent:
1) GET /auth/saml/start for tenant `acme-inc`
2) follow IdP link (goes through Akamai)
3) on POST-back, ~20% fail with `SAML validation failed: SignatureAlgorithm not supported`

nish: pulling verifier logs now. our verifier was tightened to restrict legacy algos; suspect IdP switched to ECDSA-only certs.
elena-customer: sample app log line from their support ticket:
```
2026-03-16T20:58:12Z auth: SAML assertion validation failed: Signature validation failed: algorithm 'http://www.w3.org/2001/04/xmldsig-more#ecdsa-sha256' not accepted
```

alex: also seeing metadata fetches returning 302 -> CDN host that replies with `Content-Type: text/plain`. our metadata loader ignores signed metadata unless content-type is xml or redirect whitelisted.

jamie: two likely causes: IdP rotated to ECDSA keys, AND our metadata loader skipped the new keys due to content-type/302.
nish: quick curl against their metadata:
```
$ curl -I https://idp.acme.example/meta
HTTP/1.1 302 Found
Location: https://cdn.acme.example/signed-meta
---
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8
```
With `curl -L` we get XML, but our fetcher refuses text/plain.

elena-customer: vendor confirmed their CDN normalizes content-type to text/plain for signed artifacts.

alex: mitigation plan: introduce per-tenant toggles: `allow_metadata_content_type_lax` and `allow_ecdsa_signatures`. Turn both on for acme-inc, force metadata refresh, monitor.

jamie: support please list step-by-step for customer and internal ops.
alex: Stopgap for tenant `acme-inc`:
- Set tenant config `allow_metadata_content_type_lax = true`
- Set tenant config `allow_ecdsa_signatures = true`
- Trigger metadata refresh: POST /admin/tenants/acme-inc/metadata/refresh
Expected: loader accepts CDN XML, picks up ECDSA keys, verifier accepts assertions.

nish: note: Akamai may serve stale cached metadata without ECDSA keys until cache purge. ask customer to purge CDN cache.

elena-customer: customer applied flags and did a refresh. QA ran 200 login attempts with 0 failures. :tada:

jamie: next: eng-security to review tenant toggles. add audit logging for flag changes and TTL warnings.

security-bot: notifying eng-security: review requested for tenant toggles `allow_metadata_content_type_lax`, `allow_ecdsa_signatures`.

alex: will add audit entry on toggle change (actor, timestamp, reason) and alert if enabled >72h. PR -> staging deploy.

deploy-bot: starting deploy: config/tenant-flags/2026-03-16 -> staging

jamie: final notes for ticket: recommend customer fix upstream headers (serve application/xml), or publish both RSA and ECDSA keys. closing provisional fix; monitor 48h. :white_check_mark:
